therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD47 blockade to enable macrophage-mediated phagocytosis
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell clearance via enhanced macrophage phagocytosis
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: safety and tolerability (Phase I), objective response rate (Phase II)

subgroup_findings: Higher response rate in Phase I 2.0 mg/kg group (33.3%) vs other doses
results.dose_information: Ontorpacept 0.2, 0.7, 1.0, or 2.0 mg/kg IV + Doxorubicin 75 mg/m² IV in 21-day cycles for maximum 6 cycles

context.duration: maximum treatment exposure 74.1 weeks (Phase I), 88 weeks (Phase II)
